limitations: only the file:line citation kind is truth-checked; migration and bare git-show kinds keep block-level presence, with the ceiling printed at the point of use
the check verifies a cited line holds the quoted text, not that the text supports the claim drawn from it
working-tree evidence is checked at lint time, not as of authoring
non_goals: promoting the lint to a binding VETO; it stays WARN at Step 0.6
changing check_plan's module-path and skill-path warnings
exclusions: qor-audit/SKILL.md is untouched; --repo-root is already passed

open_questions: Must a git-show citation inside an evidence statement demand its own evidence? No - infinite regress; span-based exclusion, verified by fixture in Phase 1.
What does an unresolvable path produce? Its own finding kind, on the same reasoning that keeps inconclusive separate from skip.
phases: Phase 1: parse and resolve an evidence statement -- qor/scripts/plan_grep_lint.py (EvidenceStatement, parse_evidence_statements, resolve_line, reproduces), tests/test_plan_grep_evidence_parse.py, four tests/fixtures/evidence_*.md
Phase 2: pair each citation with its own evidence -- rewrite check_citation_evidence, LintWarning.kind, tests/test_plan_grep_citation_pairing.py, retarget tests/test_plan_grep_lint.py
Phase 3: doctrine and reporting -- qor/references/doctrine-shadow-genome-countermeasures.md P1 paragraph, qor/references/glossary.md, docs/GOVERNANCE_INDEX.md, tests/test_doctrine_citation_pairing.py
ci_commands: python -m pytest tests/test_plan_grep_evidence_parse.py tests/test_plan_grep_citation_pairing.py tests/test_plan_grep_lint.py tests/test_doctrine_citation_pairing.py -q
